svg.title: Front view of a generic 42U four-post rack
svg.desc: Layered 2.5D view of an unbranded rack under an overhead ladder rack, bonded to the wall grounding busbar. Built in six steps: empty rack, cable managers, patch panels and a fiber enclosure, switches, dressed bundles with hook-and-loop wraps and label tags, then the fiber trunk, splice tray and an illustrative test trace.
